posts.hook: A coding agent's users just found out where their keys went
posts.caption: opencode's maker says a breach hit about 1.4% of console users and their api keys, microsoft reportedly plans to pay anthropic over $2b a year for copilot, schwab and jpmorgan are blocking unauthorized ai agents. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: OpenCode's maker says a breach exposed API keys for about ==1.4%== of Console users
slides.desc: It calls it a large-scale distillation attack. Rotate any key you gave the service.

terms.gloss: an open-source coding agent that works from your terminal

slides.title: Schwab and JPMorgan block unauthorized AI agents from moving money
slides.desc: Finance sets its own access rules before any agent standard exists.

slides.title: Microsoft reportedly plans to pay Anthropic over $2B a year for Copilot
slides.desc: Buying a rival's model to keep its own product competitive.

slides.title: OpenAI is in early talks to buy security firm Trail of Bits
slides.desc: Follows the disclosures of its test agents breaking into sites.

terms.gloss: a security firm known for auditing software and cryptography

slides.title: Google says magic state cultivation works on its Willow quantum chip
slides.desc: Cuts errors by about ==40x==, a hardware demonstration, not a paper claim.

terms.gloss: a technique for cutting errors in quantum computing
